lgl.sandbox: Setu is a sandbox. All money movement is simulated: no real funds are held, moved or released. These pages describe the demo service.

terms.title: Terms of use (sandbox)
terms.c1: Setu helps SMEs plan imports, financing and supplier payments. In this sandbox every payment, escrow balance and loan is simulated.
terms.c2: You are responsible for the accuracy of the details you give and for keeping your sign-in and security codes private.
terms.c3: Money actions stay locked until your business is verified by a reviewer. We may ask for more documents or decline an application.
terms.c4: Do not upload documents you are not entitled to share, or try to bypass checks. Instructions hidden inside documents are treated as data, never as commands.
terms.c5: Figures are estimates produced by fixed rules. They are not an offer of credit or a guarantee.
terms.c6: We may update these terms; the version you accepted is recorded. You can request deletion of your account at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy notice (sandbox)
privacy.c1: Your name, work email, mobile number, business details and the documents you upload so we can verify your business.
privacy.c2: Sensitive values such as licence numbers, tax numbers and bank accounts are stored encrypted and shown masked. Reviewers must give a written reason to see a full value, and that is logged.
privacy.c3: Personal and business identifiers are masked before any text reaches an AI model. Numbers are computed by code, not by the model.
privacy.c4: Only authorised reviewers and you. We do not sell data.
privacy.c5: You can download your data and request deletion from Account settings.
privacy.c6: Verification records are kept for the audit trail while the account exists. Deleted accounts are suspended and then removed.
